always: Overall key is bright and saturated: backgrounds sit in light or middle grey, almost never dark.
Darkest accents are small and local: gaps under the hero, cast shadows, openings, inner-ring holes, seat undersides, hose, and glove cuffs. They stay under about 10-15% of the card.
The hero is separated by hue and saturation as well as value. In grey, the hero often merges with the background into the same middle grey (book, boxing gloves, pump, planter, sneakers' upper).
Light values cluster on the hero's lit faces and highlights (fin blades, ticket face, awning stripes, sneaker soles, pump cap band).
Hero interiors are smooth, with soft glossy highlights and a few clear steps. Only small details (chain links, lace, window grid, thatch) are hard-edged.
The ground or floor is a separate, usually lighter band than the back wall (sand, shelf floor, pale yellow floor, tile, wood table).
varies: Background key: dark and flat behind the fins (hero lighter than background), light behind the sneakers and ticket (hero darker), mid grey behind the phone booth, carousel and gloves.
Background structure: concentric rings (neck pillow, fins, palm), vertical stripes (ticket, gloves), or a flat gradient. Rings and stripes are very low contrast and show as a faint 1-2 grey step.

Vignette: soft darker corners and an edge falloff on the ticket, neck pillow, fins and carousel. The booth and sneakers have a lighter spot or flat field, and the scene cards (pool bar, planter, pump) have none.

Hero-to-background gap is large for the fins, ticket and pillow (hero face near white or near black against mid grey). It is small for the book, gloves, pump and planter, where the hero is in the same grey group.
Scene cards (pool bar, planter, pump) fill the whole frame with five grey groups and busy mid-value texture. Single-object cards have two or three large groups.
Glow behind the hero: a pale halo behind the phone booth and a lighter patch behind the pillow. There is none behind the others.
never: Pure black backgrounds or a heavy dark vignette that crushes the edges.
A dark hero silhouette on a dark field, or a hero lost against a background of equal hue.
Hard black outlines drawn around the hero. Edges come from value steps and rim highlights.
Dramatic spot lighting or a big black shadow mass covering a large part of the card.
Gritty, noisy or grainy texture inside the hero's shaded areas.
generator_wording: Bright, saturated card with light-to-mid backgrounds and no heavy dark areas. Hero has smooth glossy shading with soft highlights, plus small dark accents only in gaps, openings and under-shadows. Separate hero from background by hue as well as value. Faint low-contrast rings or stripes behind it, soft slightly darker corners, no black outlines.
